description: CHARLOTTE, NC – In her race for Senate District 42, Stacie McGinn launched a second digital ad titled “I’ll Show Up” - focusing on HB 307 “Iryna’s Law” and her opponent Woodson Bradley’s failure to appear for the final vote.
paid_for_by: PAID FOR BY STACIE MCGINN FOR NC SENATE bottom of page
title: Stacie McGinn Slams Woodson Bradley for Missing Final Vote on “Iryna’s Law” in Second Digital Ad
